entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: Drawn as three stick figures on the left side of the diagram representing internal NHS Digital teams.

entities.name: EC2 (Gateway)
entities.rationale: Represented by the orange EC2 cube on the left side of the vertical dashed boundary, acting as a Guacamole gateway.

entities.name: AD
entities.rationale: Represented by the green AWS Directory Service icon labeled 'AD' at the bottom center of the secure sandbox area.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Represented by the orange EMR icon labeled 'EMR' in the center of the diagram.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Represented by the blue RDS database cylinder icon labeled 'RDS' at the top center.

entities.name: KMS
entities.rationale: Represented by the blue square box labeled 'KMS' at the top right.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Represented by the orange S3 icon labeled 'S3' in the middle right.

entities.name: EC2 (Sandbox Compute)
entities.rationale: Represented by the orange EC2 cube labeled 'EC2' at the bottom right.

visual_connections.description: Arrow from the middle stick figure pointing directly to the gateway EC2 instance.
Curved green arrow flowing from the gateway EC2 down across the dashed line into AD for authentication.
Direct horizontal arrow pointing from EMR to S3 for querying and processing data.
Arrow pointing upward from S3 to KMS indicating encryption key usage.
Curved arrow from KMS pointing towards RDS indicating encryption.
Curved green arrow pointing upward from the lower EC2 instance to S3.
